items.quote: Several respondents noted that San Tamake headed presentations to senior management, setting priorities for several teams.
Peers observed that San led the decision to decline vendor hospitality during a tender across the department.
Several respondents noted that San spearheaded the team's recovery after a major project setback at the national level.
Several respondents noted that San Tamake championed service-level targets for frontline operations and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
San set the direction for incident management during the ransomware attack across the public service.
Direct reports said that San Tamake drove tracing how a delay in one agency rippled through to others for the whole division.
Direct reports said that San led change management after the merger of two units across the department.
